scripts.setup-all: npm run setup && echo "Download Golang dependencies..." && go mod download && go mod verify
scripts.upgrade-all: npx npm-check-updates -u && npm run setup && echo "Update Golang dependencies..." && go get -u ./...
scripts.lint: prettier --check src package.json docs/openapi-v2.yaml vite.config.ts tsconfig.json svelte.config.js && eslint ./src/**/*.{ts,svelte}
scripts.build:mobile: vite build --mode mobile && cap sync android
scripts.android: npm run build:mobile && cap open android
scripts.build-all: npm run build && echo "Building Golang binary..." && CGO_ENABLED=1 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-linkmode 'external' -extldflags '-lstdc++ -lssl -lcrypto' -s -w" -buildvcs=false -mod=readonly -v -o xivi .
scripts.build-all-win: npm run build && echo "Building Golang binary..." && go build -trimpath -ldflags "-linkmode 'external' -extldflags '-lstdc++ -lssl -lcrypto' -s -w" -buildvcs=false -mod=readonly -v -o xivi .
scripts.docker-run: open-cli http://localhost:3000 && docker run -p 3000:3000 -v serve:/xivi/serve -v config:/xivi/config --rm xivi
